terminology_note: The expected 12 count maps to the persisted daily Discord audit field reentry_after_no_progress_count_day. Case stop_time is the prior no_progress_exit observer_exit time; reentry_exit_reason records whether the reENTRY itself later stopped.

observed_counts.note: Persisted same_symbol_reentry_count_day is 39 while event-stream reconstruction has 38 because daily_symbol_discord_state.json has one extra recorded 278A.T entry_count versus the retained accepted event rows. STOP-after and same-PUSH counts reconstruct exactly.

case_definition.stop_after_reentry_filter: accepted ENTRY with same-day entry_count>=2 and immediately prior symbol observer_exit reason containing no_progress
case_definition.elapsed_seconds: accepted reENTRY event_time minus previous no_progress_exit exit_time
case_definition.pnl_basis: observer_exit pnl_pct plus 100-share yen equivalent computed from entry/exit prices when pnl_yen_100 is absent

thirty_min_cooloff_counterfactual.rule: Block reENTRY when elapsed_seconds < 1800 after prior no_progress_exit; keep elapsed >= 1800.

cost_aware_judgment.basis: nearest same-symbol cost-aware shadow selection in same session; summary has no per-official-entry flag
